 Looking for something exciting to watch on OTT this week? Telugu cinema has some interesting new releases lined up, bringing a mix of thrillers, comedy and family drama. From supernatural mysteries to unexpected wedding chaos, there's something for every entertainment lover!
 1. 418 – Netflix | November 20, 2026 
 Starring Chaitra J Achar, 418 is a supernatural psychological horror thriller directed by Kirtan Nadagouda. The story revolves around an abandoned medical college building that is reopened after 15 years. Soon, strange incidents begin to unfold, leading to a terrifying mystery surrounding Room No. 418.
 2. Anumana Pakshi – Sun NXT | November 20, 2026 
 Starring Rag Mayur, Merin Philip and Prince Cecil, Anumana Pakshi is a comedy thriller directed by Vimal Krishna. The story follows Sunny, a content creator who travels to Kashmir after receiving a disturbing call from his friend. What follows is a series of unexpected events, mystery and suspense.
 3. Crazy Kalyanam – Aha | November 20, 2026 
 Featuring Anupama Parameswaran, Crazy Kalyanam promises an entertaining dose of wedding drama and comedy. The film brings a fun-filled story for viewers who enjoy lighthearted Telugu entertainers.
 4. Kiku Chiranjeevi – Aha | November 14, 2026 
 Kiku Chiranjeevi is another Telugu title available to stream on Aha. The film is part of this week's OTT watchlist for audiences looking to explore more regional entertainment.
 Whether you enjoy suspense-filled stories or lighthearted family entertainers, these Telugu OTT releases deserve a spot on your watchlist.
